extracted.name: Quick Lemon Poppy Seed Bread
extracted.description: Lemon cake and pudding mixes combine forces with a scoop of poppy seeds to make one of the easiest versions of this popular dessert bread.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3 ounce) package instant lemon pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour 2 - 8x4 inch loaf pans.
In a large bowl, mix together the cake mix, eggs, oil, pudding mix, water, and poppy seeds. Spread batter into two greased 8x4 inch loaf pans.
Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean.
